title: Courts-martial; nonjudicial punishment.
bodyText: Any limitations in chapter 124B to the contrary notwithstanding, whenever this chapter specifically authorizes an act to be punished by court-martial or nonjudicial punishment, the court-martial may be convened or nonjudicial punishment imposed and punishment administered as though the act complained of were a violation of the punitive articles of chapter 124B.
bodyHtml: §122A-16  Courts-martial; nonjudicial punishment.  Any limitations in chapter 124B to the contrary notwithstanding, whenever this chapter specifically authorizes an act to be punished by court-martial or nonjudicial punishment, the court-martial may be convened or nonjudicial punishment imposed and punishment administered as though the act complained of were a violation of the punitive articles of chapter 124B. [L 1987, c 35, pt of §1; am L 2022, c 286, §4]
